warnings: Ø-symbol callouts on this detail sheet are recorded as type RB per schema §0.6 (go by the printed symbol only), even where the notes sheet S-01 ข้อ 2.2 specifies ข้ออ้อย SD-40 for ≥12 mm — the same convention/conflict already recorded on house 14. The conflict applies to every ø12 callout on S-05..S-09.

F2's detail plan is drawn rotated 90° relative to the building plan: detail 1.00 wide × 1.30 tall = building 1.30 along x × 1.00 along y (matches the 1.35/1.30/1.35 chain on S-02/S-03). Grid positions in this file use building coordinates.

F2 has no conventional footing cap: the two piles are topped with 0.50 m of infill concrete and a 1.00 m ø12 dowel each, and carry the landing beam B0 + slab S0 directly. height_mm is null for that reason, not because the sheet failed to print it.

The 0.30|0.30 dimension pair printed astride the pedestal centreline in section 3-3 (and repeated on S-06/S-07's sections) does not match any pile or pedestal spacing derivable from the plans (pile offsets are ±0.25 from centre); its meaning is unresolved and it is deliberately left un-interpreted.

F3 mat (from the dedicated ผังเหล็ก diagram): each direction = 3ø12 + 4ø9, where the 4ø9 of the long direction are split 2+2 near the two edges and the 4ø9 of the short direction sit in the tapered corner zone. Section 3-3's twin callouts '3ø12 มม+4ø9 มม' confirm both directions.
